campaign_name: Constitution Progress and Benchmark Governance Review
purpose: Read-only amendment proposal for failure classification, root cause, generalization, architectural restraint, progress claims, and gameplay-benchmark governance. No constitution edit and no benchmark implementation.
objective_status: PROPOSAL READY FOR REVIEW — NOT ADOPTED
executive_summary: The Constitution already separates structural PASS from semantic success, requires the smallest justified change, and delegates the review ZIP, evidence packets, systemic-repair fixtures, playability scoring, and replay failure rows to specialized authorities. It does not classify development failures, require an earliest-cause finding, or stop a single reproduction from being called a generalized solution. The ZIP is not a constitutional clause; the review-handoff standard already requires it for significant work and already allows a lightweight note for small work. Recommended package: short Constitution sections for failure classes, task proportion, architectural restraint, and claim separation; a progress paragraph in the existing review summary; benchmark rules in the Validation Evidence Standard; a cross-reference in Product Realization validation. Do not add a second handoff, a replay-taxonomy change, a per-block provider call, or the benchmark corpus.
